common.order_policy: select independently in full, first-half, and second-half records; full-record order is diagnostic only and must not be imposed on local segments

scalar_layer.matching_policy: pole-space matching only after segment-local order selection

modal_layer.matching_policy: carrier matching by MAC/subspace; do not use pole proximity as the primary cross-state carrier matcher

system_layer.representation: tuple(local observable order, observable-subspace projector, normalized channel participation, crowding-aware resolved-cluster pole geometry); never collapse to a whole-system scalar
system_layer.unequal_local_order_policy: REFUSE_CURRENT_COMPARISON_AND_REPORT_ORDER_CHANGE_OPEN_CHANNEL; P0 candidate-pair bookkeeping may be reported separately but shared/lost/added scientific adjudication remains unresolved and is not a selector input.

claim_ceiling: P0 engineering and structural-method development only. No prospective confirmation, EEG, diagnosis, treatment, causality, whole-system scalar, preferred chi value, regime boundary, or cross-domain mechanism claim.
protocol_baseline: General Cross-Project Research Protocol v0.7.1 FINAL, 2026-09-10
threshold_status: Inherited from pre-v0.7.1 Phase0D v0.1 candidate for P0 regression only. Not authorized as P1 thresholds until MFR-14 is complete and a new freeze is committed.

comparator.policy: DMD is the leading direct neural structural comparator candidate from the source-of-record review and its basic implementation passes deterministic known-truth P0 qualification. Comparator identity, common challenge matrix, scoring rule, and any ADDS claim remain unfrozen.

uncertainty.policy: Interval integrity, explicit INDETERMINATE semantics, and descriptive repeated-known-truth calibration are implemented and tested. Reynders-style analytical SSI single-record uncertainty is not implemented. No confidence level, simultaneous-coverage rule, or P1 uncertainty decision rule is frozen.

model_adequacy.policy: SSI-COV now exposes its discrete realization for adequacy diagnostics. Positive-lag covariance reconstruction, residual serial-structure diagnostics, and independent output-prediction diagnostics are implemented separately. A wrong but stable synthetic realization is demonstrably distinguishable from the correct one. No adequacy threshold, lag/search-space rule, or P1 conjunctive adjudication rule is frozen.

unequal_order_tracking.policy: Unequal-order matching reports candidate pairs, assignment margins, and unmatched candidates only. Exact ties remain visibly ambiguous. Shared/lost/added semantics are not scientifically assigned until a frozen uncertainty-aware rule is justified and prospectively tested.

lineage_from: Phase 0C v0.2 failure audit and Phase 0D development calibration only; Phase 0C v0.2 remains FAIL and is not rescored
